question: 在 MCAR 缺失机制下，均值插补与中位数插补对有偏分布数据的恢复误差有何差异？结论是否随损失函数及数据分布改变？
scope: Literature review and reproducible local simulation only; no clinical or general missing-data recommendation.

data.randomGenerator: mulberry32-v1 with Box-Muller normal draws; implementation must be saved and reviewed before execution
data.maskRule: For each replicate and fraction, choose floor(n*fraction) indices by a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle independent of values. Both methods use identical data and mask.
data.fittingRule: Estimate mean and median only from observed entries. Hidden ground truth is used only to score missing entries.
data.replicationRule: Generate independent data and mask streams per replicate and condition; persist stream seeds. Individual missing cells are not independent experimental replicates.

analysis.primaryMetric: Mean squared error on masked entries, averaged across independent replicates
analysis.secondaryMetric: Mean absolute error on masked entries; exploratory, reported separately from the primary endpoint
analysis.contrast: Per-replicate MSE(mean imputation) minus MSE(median imputation); negative favors mean, positive favors median
analysis.experimentalUnit: Independent simulation replicate, paired across methods
analysis.confidenceInterval: Paired percentile bootstrap of replicate differences, 10000 resamples, 95% interval, fixed recorded bootstrap seed
analysis.practicalEffect: Absolute mean MSE difference divided by mean MSE of mean imputation; 0.02 threshold. Report raw differences too.
analysis.interpretation: Separate interval exclusion of zero, practical effect and design limitations. Non-significance does not establish equivalence. MAE cannot replace the prespecified primary MSE after observing outcomes.
analysis.additionalConditions: Other distributions and missing fractions are exploratory robustness checks; no uncorrected confirmatory multiple-testing claims.

insufficientEvidenceControl.rule: Fewer than 30 replicates requires inconclusive/review regardless of an apparently narrow interval

analysis.symmetricControl: Normal distribution is a control for generalization; do not force a null or a preferred winner. Mean and median estimates can differ in finite samples.

stopping.rule: Stop on documented design completion, explicit limitation, unresolved review or exhausted budget; no optional stopping based on favorable p-values.

budget.cost: Unknown unless explicitly returned by provider; no invented price conversion

literature.seedPolicy: Starting URLs are human-supplied discovery hints, not verified evidence or a substitute for autonomous search. Retrieve and assess relevance, reading scope and supporting quotes.

approval.rule: The baseline stops at approval; lack of execution is recorded, never synthesized. Any later explicit experiment approval must name the immutable proposal.
